obligations.instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.

semantics.definition: An ordinarily intangible field or a monolithic environmental surface itself becomes a handleable layer in the depicted world, rather than a separate covering, printed representation or ordinary flexible object. One acting hand or held tool contacts that same layer; its continuous local deformation leads to a readable still-attached boundary. An exposed reverse, substrate or recessed interior plus material-specific folds, sag, thickness, occlusion or contact shadow makes the handling visible in an otherwise coherent scene. Peeling, creasing, gathering, rolling and unzipping are distinct alternatives. No second creature, repeated cross-surface world rule or non-Euclidean doorway is required.
